WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM main.orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
), customer_orders AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM delivered
    WHERE customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
), prices AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS price
    FROM main.order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
), payments AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS paid
    FROM main.order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_order_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS delivered_orders,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(d.customer_unique_id) AS rows_without_customer,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(JULIANDAY(d.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS rows_without_valid_timestamp,
       MIN(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase,
       MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(i.price) AS rows_without_price,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(p.paid) AS rows_without_payment,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN ABS(i.price - p.paid) >= 0.01 THEN 1 END) AS rows_with_different_price_and_payment,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_orders) AS customers,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_orders WHERE order_count = 1) AS one_order_customers
FROM delivered AS d
LEFT JOIN prices AS i ON i.order_id = d.order_id
LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id

WITH payments_per_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment
    FROM main.order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders,
        AVG(p.order_payment) AS average_payment_per_order,
        JULIANDAY(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp))
            - JULIANDAY(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS lifespan_days
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN payments_per_order AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
    customer_unique_id,
    number_of_orders,
    average_payment_per_order,
    CASE
        WHEN lifespan_days < 7 THEN 1.0
        ELSE lifespan_days / 7.0
    END AS customer_lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC, customer_unique_id
LIMIT 3

    FROM main.film_actor AS fa

),

    SELECT a.actor_id, COUNT(rk.film_rank) AS paid_films,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rk.film_rank = 3 THEN rk.revenue END) AS third_revenue,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rk.film_rank = 4 THEN rk.revenue END) AS fourth_revenue
    FROM main.actor AS a

)

    WHERE s.points > 0

event_points AS (

    WHERE r.year >= 2001

),
